depiction.primary_object: square page or note with three text lines
modifiers: curved arrow in lower left pointing up-right into page
depiction.composition: single bordered note icon with lower-left overlay arrow

readings.meaning: restore or recover a document or note
import or insert content into a file
return or submit a form or document
reopen or revisit an archived note

ambiguity: Can be confused with share/export note, reply to message, or undo text edit icons, especially at small sizes where arrow direction relative to the frame is subtle.

modifier_semantics.modifier: curved arrow pointing up-right into page
modifier_semantics.meaning: restore, import, return, or bring back into the document
